data.body: Measured on a store copy (9,746 entries), graph cache deleted before each run, summary of 3 ids (d70a-97d9, d40f-1154, 0076-375d): before (origin/main 6acef632) 3 whole-store passes, 29,238 ticket reductions, tracemalloc peak 44.8 MB; after 1 pass, 9,746 reductions, peak 47.1 MB (the shared states stay alive across the ids, about 2 MB more). Output JSON-equal. All 3 sampled ids read 'ready' on the copy; the blocked path is covered by the fixture test (blocked, ready, unblocked-by-closed, archived, session_log, unknown ids, equal to the per-id loop).
